title: Regenerating the provider instructions
intro: One policy, several provider instruction files, generated deterministically. Running it twice leaves byte-identical files, which is what makes a stamp able to detect a hand edit.

scenarios.title: The projections have never been generated
scenarios.explain: Each target named in the policy's projections is written, and a stamp of each is recorded together with the hash of the policy that produced it.

scenarios.title: Running it again with nothing changed
scenarios.explain: Deterministic output is not a nicety here. If regeneration produced a different file each time, a stamp could never distinguish a hand edit from the generator's own noise.
